interpretation: Run every predicate against every cohort member. A null result is preserved as a control outcome, not treated as failed research or evidence of absence outside measured sources.

predicates.subject: A candidate or officeholder committee controlled by the cohort member records a disbursement to an entity in which that member has a contemporaneous disclosed beneficial interest.
predicates.required_time_test: The disbursement and disclosed interest windows overlap.
predicates.evidence_floor: Identifier-resolved official campaign-finance record plus a source-addressable beneficial-interest record.
predicates.allowed_language: The committee recorded a disbursement to an entity in which the officeholder had a disclosed beneficial interest during the overlapping period.

predicates.subject: A federal agency records an award or payment to an entity in which the cohort member has a contemporaneous disclosed beneficial interest.
predicates.required_time_test: The payment, office, and disclosed interest windows overlap or the non-overlap is explicitly reported.
predicates.evidence_floor: Identifier-resolved official federal spending or agency payment record plus a source-addressable beneficial-interest record.
predicates.allowed_language: A federal source recorded a payment to an entity in which the officeholder had a disclosed beneficial interest during the stated period.

predicates.subject: A foreign-state-controlled payer is documented making a payment to an entity in which the cohort member has a contemporaneous disclosed beneficial interest.
predicates.required_time_test: The payment and disclosed interest windows overlap.
predicates.evidence_floor: Source-addressable transaction evidence, a sourced state-control predicate, and a source-addressable beneficial-interest record.
predicates.allowed_language: A documented foreign-state-controlled payer made a payment to an entity in which the officeholder had a disclosed beneficial interest.

predicates.subject: The cohort member reports a beneficial equity interest in a publicly reporting issuer during presidential service.
predicates.required_time_test: The disclosed interest and office windows overlap.
predicates.evidence_floor: Public financial disclosure plus identifier-resolved securities filing or issuer record.
predicates.allowed_language: The officeholder disclosed an equity interest in a public issuer during the overlapping office period.

predicates.subject: A disclosed private financial interest is documented before a later official act classified to the same bounded policy or commercial domain.
predicates.required_time_test: The interest predates the act; domain classification and the observation window are explicit.
predicates.evidence_floor: Public financial disclosure plus an official policy, order, rule, appointment, procurement, or enforcement record.
predicates.allowed_language: A disclosed private interest preceded a later official act in the same bounded domain; causation and motive are not established.
